title: Learn Python Programming
description: Learn Python 3 programming language within a month using our practical course. Understand the basic syntax of Python using our online tutorial. Prepare for a future in data science, AI and ML.

Syllabus.title: Output / Print in Python
Syllabus.description: Learn how to make Python print whatever you want, and learn to use it as a basic calculator.
Lesson: Print text and numbers using single print

Syllabus.title: Variables and datatypes
Syllabus.description: Learn how to make Python store data and manipulate them
Lesson: Boolean data type and negative numbers

Syllabus.title: Operators
Syllabus.description: Learn about the various operators in Python

Syllabus.title: Strings
Syllabus.description: Till now, we have mostly worked with numbers. Learn to also work with text

Syllabus.title: User inputs
Syllabus.description: How do we get a user to input data to the Python code?

Syllabus.title: Conditional statements
Syllabus.description: Get Python to take decisions based on some conditions that you specify

Syllabus.title: Debug your code
Syllabus.description: Learn to debug common errors that you will encounter while writing code

Syllabus.title: Lists
Syllabus.description: Store vast amounts of data and access them easily using lists.

Syllabus.title: Loops
Syllabus.description: Make Python perform similar tasks a million times, using iteration.

Syllabus.title: Functions in python
Syllabus.description: Learn to use functions in Python
